about: E15's proof (slice B, Task 4): requests sent with the moment the video was paused on, each made on the house first cut of the owner's take, three runs each. m: six that point at the paused frame. n: three with no pointing word, where the tag alone is the pointer (S13, S15). c: five requests about the whole video, sent with a moment, which should still change the whole video, and two that name another place, which should land there. A moment is a word's index in the take or a share of the film, never a word's text; frame is the film frame it gives on that first cut. Every text asked to be written is made up. allowed: the pointing words the requests may use.
